title: Verify and correct 0.3.5's qualification citation in lore-cli-release-truth.md
description: release-truth.md's 0.3.5 entry cites 'opum-cli-e2e's 407-row matrix, 402 PASS / 0 FAIL / 0 BLOCKED against the quest 0.3.0 candidate bundle' as that release's qualification evidence (added in commit d80b2c4, 2026-08-30). The SAME commit, same author, same day, introduced a separate lessons-learned note in docs/reference/lore-cli-repository-notes.md: 'opum-cli-e2e disclosed a green 402-row run they refused to use, because its bundle was misattributed. A green number from the wrong artifact is the most confident possible false clear.' Same '402,' unclear from lore-cli's side whether release-truth.md is citing the accepted run or the refused one. Independently of that question: 402 PASS + 0 FAIL + 0 BLOCKED only accounts for 402 of the stated 407 rows -- 5 rows are unexplained regardless of which run this is. Surfaced 2026-09-09 while working LCLI-333 and auditing release-truth.md for the same staleness class that affected its 0.5.0 entry (fixed in PR #624 -- see LCLI-333's notes for that history). Audit scope established: release-truth.md is the ONLY document in this repository carrying a cross-repo qualification citation at all; CHANGELOG.md's own per-commit bun test counts are a different, lower-risk class since they describe lore-cli's own runs, not another repository's evidence -- swept docs/reference/ and docs/adr/ directly, not assumed.

acceptanceCriteria.text: opum-cli-e2e confirms whether the cited 402-PASS/407-row 0.3.5 run is the accepted quest-0.3.0-candidate qualification or the misattributed run their own lessons-learned note describes as refused
The 5-row discrepancy (407 stated rows vs 402 PASS+0 FAIL+0 BLOCKED accounted for) is explained or corrected regardless of which run this turns out to be
release-truth.md's 0.3.5 entry is corrected if the citation is wrong, or annotated with confirmation evidence if it checks out
The audit scope finding (release-truth.md is the only doc in this repo carrying this citation class) is recorded here for future reference rather than re-derived

implementationNotes: RESOLVED (2026-09-09), from opum-cli-e2e's own committed evidence. NOT the misattributed/refused run — that bundle (sourceCommit 5ef5e578) was discarded before ever being written to their evidence/ or baselines/, so it's not cited anywhere. The 402/402 figure was real and correctly attributed (evidence/pair-quest030-lore035/, commit c69b58a, 2026-08-29) but measured a LOCALLY PACKED lore 0.3.5 candidate — superseded because Bun's --compile isn't byte-reproducible across machines, so the candidate's native binary digest (46818b7b6552...) doesn't match what actually published (e40154bd757d...). The terminal, correct citation is evidence/rank1-pair-published/ (commit 3c0a550, 2026-08-30): 403 rows, 403 PASS/0 FAIL/0 BLOCKED, quest 0.3.0 AND lore 0.3.5 both installed from the published npm registry — opum-cli-e2e's own TASK-22 summary names this as terminal. The '407-row' figure was simply wrong regardless of which run was meant: it's baselines/v0.2.9's pre-candidate-binding row count, not any pair-qualification total; their README documents 407->402 as candidate-binding's expected net effect. Fixed in docs/reference/lore-cli-release-truth.md, branch fix/LCLI-461-release-truth-0.3.5-citation, citing the corrected 403/403/0/0 evidence with the digest-mismatch explanation for why the earlier number was superseded.
